key.name: server-url
key.description: Normalised base URL of the Kimai installation. The API token is stored in the system keyring, never here.

key.name: last-project
key.description: Kimai ID of the project most recently used to start tracking. 0 if none.

key.name: last-activity
key.description: Kimai ID of the activity most recently used to start tracking. 0 if none.

key.name: start-behavior
key.description: Whether starting by shortcut or action uses the last project and activity, or opens the window to choose.

key.name: global-shortcut-enabled
key.description: Ask the GlobalShortcuts portal for a shortcut that toggles tracking while the app is running.
